item.title: Mou Suki ni Shite Kudasai ~Ryoujoku to Kusari to Himitsu no Ana~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: System Rose
  • 発売日: 2000-06-02
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: もう好きにしてください～凌辱と鎖と秘密の穴～
  • 英語名: Mou Suki ni Shite Kudasai Ryoujoku to Kusari to Himitsu no Ana

あらすじ

There is an old western mansion on the hill of a small fisherman’s town. It is owned by a chairman of a certain company. Main character is the son of that chairman. He lives in the mansion with four women servants. As of late he starts to pay them a lot of attention in attempt to record juicy moments on the camera.

  • 日本語名: 暁の岩礁

あらすじ

Main character is a teacher at a private girls’ school. One day he and his students set off on excursion to Yokohama port and then by luxurious liner “Ingleb” to Hong Kong. However, they fall into a trap set by someone just before departure. Will they survive?
